server.fact: SELECT cardid,mobid FROM monstercarddata populates map; getCardMobId returns mapped MobID, unboxes Integer (absent row is not silently zero).
characterInfo writes book level,normal,special,total then SQL-mapped cover MobID when character cover card>0, else0.
set-field monsterbook data is different: raw cover cardID as int; cardIDs modulo10000 as short, card counts/levels as byte.

browser.fact: parse_monsterbook consumes int raw cover cardID,skip byte,short size,(short cardID,byte level) entries.
Only stores cover and cards map. No asset lookup/UI implemented here.

consumer_facts.browser_scope: Read-only inspection of the above paths and MonsterBook references under src/client found storage/packet parser and MonsterBook/cardGet effect, not complete Monster Book/cover UI. No browser parity claim; no shared checkout edits.

native_static.fact: String-pool0xef6→Item/Consume/0238.img;0x3c1→info;0x639→mob;0x635→iconRaw. Enumeration cardID stored at card+0, info/mob at card+4. Index maps cardID; no SQL mapping consumed client-side.
String-pool0x8bf→String/MonsterBook.img, keys enumerated decimal MobID and stored map at manager+0x88. Reads map0x3b6,reward0x8c3,episode0x8c2. Not Etc/MonsterBook.img.
GetCard(cardID) then manager+0x88 lookup using card+4 (item info/mob). Cover SQL map is separate; do not force equalization.

Gets CMobTemplate with card+4 at0x866c88; formats Mob/%07d.img using same value at0x866cd6. At0x867202 passes card+0 to GetString0x685b79; null at0x867213→0x8676ab skips optional metadata panels. Seven source-missing metadata nodes are genuine absence, not an identity/art prerequisite.
Calls CActionMan loader0x40c831 with MobID at0x8678d4 and action index at0x8678d3; available actions vary by card level. This does not certify boss combat action/effect support.

native_lineage.observed: Static IDB analysis only; no executable launch, injection, native UI screenshots or runtime parity exercised.
